text:
Maya: quick note  can we add a tiny 'snapshot' preflight that runs before smoke benches? catch tokenizer/ABI/shape mismatches early.
Liam: yes, saves bench cycles. what's the lightest useful check?
Sofia: token id probes for a few canonical strings, kv-cache shape/dtype sanity, and a 1-step micro-forward to confirm shape + coarse numeric check.
Arjun: keep it tiny: the micro-forward should use a static tiny input and a relative-L2 threshold against a stored snapshot.
Maya: agree. goal <1s on a warmed sandbox. flow: token-probe -> micro-forward -> if pass enqueue bench, else short-circuit and persist structured reasons.
Liam: structured failures only: reason_code, component, short_evidence. this makes analytics trivial.
Sofia: also gate-version the preflight (semver) and record gate_version in model metadata for reproducibility.
Arjun: goldens must be small and immutable in blobstore, keyed by model-family+gate_version. updates require approval.
Maya: tolerance enum for quantized models: lenient/medium/strict in intake.yaml, default=medium. doc this clearly.
DevOpsBot: note: preflight-v1 scheduled on intake-workers pool image=ml-sandbox:v2026-09-01.
Liam: action items: I'll draft schema + short runbook.
Sofia: I'll prototype micro-runner and test on cpu/gpu images; PR by Friday.
Maya: ensure logs redact weights and tensors; only hashes and short evidence. Also add UI: quick snapshot badge with link to evidence and rerun button.
Arjun: alerting: create metric entry_preflight.fail_rate and page if >3 fails/hour across org.
DevOpsBot: metric.created: metric.entry_preflight_fail_rate (1m/5m).
Maya: thanks all, tagging @Liam @Sofia for followups :thumbsup:
